hero.title: Our Story
hero.subtitle: A family's passion for bringing Mediterranean excellence to Saudi Arabia

intro.quote: We believe every great dish starts with exceptional ingredients
intro.paragraph1: Founded in 2015, Food Sources Trading Co. began with a simple mission: to connect Saudi Arabia's finest culinary establishments with the authentic flavors of the Mediterranean.
intro.paragraph2: What started as a small family business has grown into one of the region's most trusted suppliers of premium olives, cheeses, and pickles. Today, we're proud to serve over 500 hotels, restaurants, and catering businesses across the Kingdom.
